formatDescription: The Dr. Halo Image Palette stores colour palette information for the Dr. Halo Image Data format. Having a separate colour palette file aloows the ability to change the stored colours of an image without re-encoding the image data.

internalSignatures.name: Dr. Halo Image Palette
internalSignatures.provenance: Note, bytes 0x0F, 0x11, and 0x13 are likely to always be 00 as according to the file structure described here: http://www.fileformat.info/format/drhalo/egff.htm, each represents the larger half of a 32 bit (WORD) value representing a value that can only have up to 256 values - MaxRed, MaxGreen, MaxBlue, e.g. FF00 = 256. This could be used to strengthen the signature in the event of accidental clashes
